answer: One shale kiln per identity: lock a 70-credit bond, file one log per epoch listing clay, energy, tile output. Tiles ship on a river barge whose manifest lists serials; auditors recompute output from clay and energy against it, burning the bond on mismatch, missing entry, or reused serial. A fable filing, a fabricated log with no matching clay or barge record, fails likewise. Fees rise by queue: first 26, kth 26+9(k-1), 1000th 9017; 1000 fakes lock 70000 and pay 4521500, each needing a kiln, log, manifest. Rented kilns fail on key mismatch. Honest identities pay 26 once and recover the bond.
